summary: One concurrency defect remains in the new guarded deployment procedure after the phase freeze ends.

major.title: R1: Capture and image replacement are not conditional on the same Deployment version.
major.detail:
Capture and image replacement are not conditional on the same Deployment version. capture-rollback-ref.sh reads the Deployment once, then reads ReplicaSets/pods and performs registry requests; the guard subsequently runs unconditional kubectl set image. After FREEZE_RELEASED, two operators can both capture healthy image A, then deploy B and C respectively. C's recorded rollback is A rather than B, and C can overwrite B while its rollout is incomplete despite the advertised completed-rollout gate. The generated build-image.yml guard has the same defect; its concurrency group serializes builds only.

Fix (reviewer proposal, not applied): Serialize capture-through-rollout across all deployment writers, or carry the captured Deployment UID/resourceVersion into an atomic conditional image update that rejects intervening changes. Apply the protection to both guard sources and add an interleaving test showing that a changed Deployment prevents the second write.
